description: Defines the UberQuicStreamIdManager class, which manages bidirectional and unidirectional QUIC stream IDs, including methods for stream ID allocation, limits, and state management.

classes.name: UberQuicStreamIdManager
classes.description: Manages bidirectional and unidirectional stream IDs for QUIC, providing methods for stream creation, limits, and state updates.

methods.name: UberQuicStreamIdManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream ID manager with perspective, version, delegate, and stream limits.

methods.name: MaybeAllowNewOutgoingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Checks if new outgoing bidirectional streams can be created based on max open streams.

methods.name: MaybeAllowNewOutgoingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Checks if new outgoing unidirectional streams can be created based on max open streams.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID can be allocated.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if the next outgoing unidirectional stream ID can be allocated.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingBidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing unidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseLargestPeerStreamId
methods.description: Increases the largest peer stream ID if within limits.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles stream closure.

methods.name: OnStreamsBlockedFrame
methods.description: Handles a STREAMS_BLOCKED frame.

methods.name: IsAvailableStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID is available.

methods.name: GetMaxAllowdIncomingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: GetMaxAllowdIncomingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: GetLargestPeerCreatedStreamId
methods.description: Returns the largest peer-created stream ID for bidirectional or unidirectional streams.

methods.name: next_outgoing_bidirectional_stream_id
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: next_outgoing_unidirectional_stream_id
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing unidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: max_outgoing_bidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outgoing bidirectional streams.

methods.name: max_outgoing_unidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outgoing unidirectional streams.

methods.name: max_incoming_bidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: max_incoming_unidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: advertised_max_incoming_bidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns the advertised maximum incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: advertised_max_incoming_unidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns the advertised maximum incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: outgoing_bidirectional_stream_count
methods.description: Returns the count of outgoing bidirectional streams.

methods.name: outgoing_unidirectional_stream_count
methods.description: Returns the count of outgoing unidirectional streams.
